csv_project_name: Engineering Service for Hebron Trail Overpass Phase I & II
csv_scope_of_work: The McHenry County Conservation District (the District ) is issuing a Request for Qualifications ( RFQ ) from qualified engineering firms to provide professional services related to the Hebron Trail - Overpass, Phase I Engineering, Option of Phase II Engineering, at IL Route 173 & Lange Road, in Hebron, IL 60034. The primary objective of this project is to design a safe and accessible crossing of Lange Road and a gradeseparated crossing of the Wisconsin Southern Railroad for the Hebron Trail. The proposed Hebron Trail improvements will: 1. Improve safety and accessibility at the Lange Road crossing through the implementation of enhanced pedestrian and bicycle crossing accommodations that provide a safe, accessible, and efficient connection for users of all abilities. 2. Enhance public safety by eliminating conflicts between trail users and railroad operations, thereby significantly reducing the potential for accidents and injuries. 3. Improve accessibility and regional connectivity by providing a safe, continuous, and convenient crossing of the railroad corridor for pedestrians, bicyclists, and users of all abilities. 4. Support community mobility and multimodal transportation by promoting active transportation opportunities, facilitating safe pedestrian and bicycle travel, and enhancing the overall functionality and long-term value of the Hebron Trail corridor. The proposed railroad grade-separated crossing represents a long-term, reliable solution that mitigates existing safety risks, accommodates future trail demand, and positions the Hebron Trail as a safe, accessible, and sustainable community asset for years to come.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
